dialogues.speaker: Hajanad
dialogues.text: The Shock-Boiling Device is a new and very sturdy model, capable of withstanding high usage. It even comes with its own recording functionality...

choices.text: I have to agree with you. It is very potent.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Exactly, right? Hahaha! Once you give me your official feedback, I'll make some more refinements and write my final report. Even my mentor will be left speechless, I just know it!

choices.text: I'll give it another go. Let's see where we go.

response.speaker: Hajanad
response.text: Oh, I can sense your passion beneath your stoic tone, don't you worry! Let's do our best to create ever greater alchemical potions!
